title: Alexander Darchiev, Russia’s Ambassador to the U.S., Dies at 66
summary: The death of Alexander Darchiev was announced by Russia’s foreign ministry. He was appointed to his post in Washington in 2025, as relations between the Kremlin and the White House warmed.
